#include <bits/stdc++.h>
using namespace std;
const int N = 250005;
int n, kk, P;
using ll = long long;

ll fast_pow(ll base, ll exp) {
    ll result = 1;
    while (exp > 0) {
        if (exp & 1) result = result * base % P;
        base = base * base % P;
        exp >>= 1;
    }
    return result;
}

inline int get_lowbit(int x) {
    return x & -x;
}

ll factorial[N], inv_factorial[N], dp_table[26][N];

ll recursive_dp(int current, int mask) {
    if (dp_table[current][mask] != -1) return dp_table[current][mask];
    if (mask == 0) {
        dp_table[current][mask] = factorial[n];
        for (int i = 1; i <= current; i++)
            dp_table[current][mask] = dp_table[current][mask] * (kk - i + 1) % P;
        return dp_table[current][mask];
    }
    ll &res = dp_table[current][mask];
    res = 0;
    int tmp_mask = mask - get_lowbit(mask);
    for (int sub_mask = tmp_mask; sub_mask > 0; sub_mask = (sub_mask - 1) & tmp_mask)
        res = (res + inv_factorial[mask - sub_mask] * recursive_dp(current + 1, sub_mask)) % P;
    res = (res + inv_factorial[mask] * recursive_dp(current + 1, 0)) % P;
    return res;
}

int main() {
    ios::sync_with_stdio(false);
    cin.tie(nullptr);
    cin >> n >> kk >> P;
    ll answer = fast_pow(kk, n);
    if (n & 1) {
        cout << answer << "\n";
        return 0;
    }
    factorial[0] = 1;
    for (int i = 1; i <= n; i++) factorial[i] = factorial[i - 1] * i % P;
    inv_factorial[n] = fast_pow(factorial[n], P - 2);
    for (int i = n; i > 0; --i) inv_factorial[i - 1] = inv_factorial[i] * i % P;
    memset(dp_table, -1, sizeof(dp_table));
    answer = (answer - recursive_dp(0, n) + P) % P;
    cout << answer << "\n";
    return 0;
}
